arms.gbm_funding_aligned: gbm_funding (ml.fit_gradient_boosted_quantiles, training_pairs unset, one-step pairs) fitted on the training frame in which treasury_settlement of row p is replaced by row p + 1's, so the pair (p, p + 1) trains the field from the target's own row, where serving reads it. Every other field is one-step. The last row of the frame has no successor and is no origin: its settlement is a hole. Same features (live_record.published_features(1)), fit, seed, hyper-parameters, fold grid (61 rows, refit every 21 days) and quantile grid. Lead 1 only: at the other leads the field is not an input

scale.metric: grid CRPS in bp (twice the mean pinball loss over the 23 levels of protocol v1), one number per decision day (repo_model.scoring_protocol.grid_crps)
scale.difference: d = S(reference) - S(arm); skill = mean(d) / mean(S(reference)); positive favours the arm
scale.interval: the protocol's studentized stationary bootstrap (scoring_protocol.paired_tests): mean block 10, seed 931, one-sided 95%, 10,000 draws on the pooled row, 2,000 on the regime and day-type splits; Diebold-Mariano with Newey-West lag 10 beside it
scale.pairs: B1, B2 against gbm_funding, the aligned arm and the twin; gbm_funding against the aligned arm and the twin; the aligned arm against the twin
scale.missing: a missing lead takes B1's law (scoring_protocol.fill_missing semantics), the share reported
scale.decision_days: those of #449's score (docs/research/direct-twin-449/score.json), so that the figures are those of #825 for the same days

locate: pooled; by regime of the decision day (evaluation_splits.json); by pressure-day type of the target day: month_end, quarter_end, tax_date, ordinary, and the ordinary days split into mid_month_coupon (a target day the splits call ordinary on which treasury_settlement_coupons > 0) and the rest; on all decision days and without decision day 2019-09-18 (#798); a split with fewer than 30 decision days is too thin and carries no interval
alignment_check: on the named target days, the row the as-of rule serves treasury_settlement from (InformationRule(horizon=1), both guards called) is the row the aligned arm trains it from, and is not the row the one-step pair trains it from
reading_rule: none: nothing here is a verdict and nothing registers; whether the candidate changes is Eleonora's, asked as a marked question in the pull request
